title: ArticleBody is a thin Vec<u8> wrapper with no invariants
description:
crates/core/src/article.rs: ArticleBody is a one-field struct wrapping Vec<u8> with a single from_text() constructor. It enforces no invariants (not ASCII-only, not CRLF-terminated, not size-bounded — all of those checks live in validation.rs), derives serde, and adds no behaviour beyond raw byte access.

Every call site that would write article.body.bytes can instead use Vec<u8> directly. The wrapper costs a level of indirection (article.body.bytes vs article.body) in exchange for nothing.

Two alternatives:
(1) Give ArticleBody genuine invariants worth protecting (CRLF lines, size cap) and make from_text() the only way to build a valid one. Then the type earns its existence.
(2) Replace pub body: ArticleBody with pub body: Vec<u8> and delete the wrapper. The from_text() call sites become b"...".to_vec().

If (1) is chosen, the size cap should be enforced here rather than duplicated in validation.rs.
